- Added “When NOT to use” table to clarify use cases and recommend better-suited related skills.
- Removed legacy/inlined reference documentation, checklists, and installation/readme files in favor of linked skill modules.
- Updated skill metadata in manifest and docs.

- Added a new "Shared generation policy" section detailing required rituals (seed, diversity, and quality checklist) before image edits.
- Updated workflow and reference links to point to new or consolidated locations in the repository (notably within the policies folder).
- Enhanced language for clarity and streamlined the description of typical workflows and pipelines.
- Removed `parallel-execution.md` and `skill-card.md` as references, consolidating guidance into other referenced docs.

Initial release of p-image-edit for advanced image editing and composition.

- Enables editing existing images, inpainting, wardrobe/background changes, and multi-image composition.
- Supports both asynchronous and synchronous editing workflows via Pruna API.
- Allows prompt-based edits with flexible parameters (e.g., aspect ratio, turbo mode, seed).
- Designed for integration with avatar, video, and multi-scene narrative pipelines.
- Includes workflow guidance for chaining edits, upscaling, and preparing outputs for downstream use.

- Initial release of p-image-edit for advanced image editing and multi-image composition.
- Supports wardrobe and background changes, inpaint-style adjustments, and edits based on reference photos.
- API instructions for uploading references and creating async/sync edits with customizable parameters.
- Guidance for avatar pipelines, multi-scene videos, and visual transition reels included.
- Details on required and optional input fields, with best practices for quality and workflow integration.
